name: create_health_endpoint_rust
prompts: This Cargo project (Cargo.toml already lists axum, tokio, serde, and serde_json as dependencies) needs a src/main.rs. Using Axum, create a GET /health endpoint that responds with JSON {"status": "ok"}, and have the server listen on 0.0.0.0:8004.

setup_files.Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "health_endpoint"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"

[dependencies]
axum = "0.7"
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["full"] }
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"

test_setup_files.test_health.py:
import subprocess, sys, time, json, urllib.request, urllib.error, os
subprocess.run(['cargo', 'build', '--offline'], check=True)
bin_path = os.path.join(os.environ.get('CARGO_TARGET_DIR', 'target'), 'debug', 'health_endpoint')
srv = subprocess.Popen([bin_path])
try:
    body = None
    for _ in range(30):
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8004/health', timeout=1) as resp:
                assert resp.status == 200, f'expected 200, got {resp.status}'
                body = json.loads(resp.read())
            break
        except (urllib.error.URLError, ConnectionResetError):
            time.sleep(0.5)
    assert body is not None, 'server never became reachable on :8004'
    assert body.get('status') == 'ok', f'unexpected body: {body!r}'
finally:
    srv.terminate()
    try:
        srv.wait(timeout=5)
    except Exception:
        srv.kill()
print('PASS')
